title: Government people pushed an alien narrative on him
summary: Chris Bledsoe tells of Government people pushed an alien narrative on him, about 2007-present at unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: They had from the beginning they they tried to make me believe in flying saucers and little green men.

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe, who says he has had many encounters with UFOs since 2007, told the podcast host Jesse Michels that government people tried from the start to steer what he believed. He says they kept pushing him to believe in flying saucers and little green men. His point is that someone wanted to shape how he explained his own experiences.
